messages:
emma-cs: Heads-up — Orbitro (acct ORB-778) just hit a service suspension after dunning. They uploaded a PO but billing still shows unpaid.

emma-cs: Invoice INV-2026-034, amount €18,200. Customer says they are VAT-exempt (EU customer). They attached PO PO-99321 and a VAT exemption cert. Requesting reinstatement so their integrations don't fail in prod.

emma-cs: Screenshot + files -> https://files.redwood/internal/ORB-778/invoice-evidence

michael-finance: Got it. Can you paste the invoice link and the PO number here? I'll pull the ledger and check tax flags.

emma-cs: Invoice link -> https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-034
emma-cs: PO# PO-99321

billing-bot: dunning-bot: notice_sent -> 2026-06-11T09:12:03Z; escalation_stage -> final_notice; auto_suspend -> triggered

lara-risk: Quick Qs: 1) Any chargebacks before? 2) Is the account on net-30 historically? 3) Has the PO been matched to the invoice in AR?

ryan-support: If finance can confirm docs are valid, we can flip service to provisional-only (allow token requests for existing keys but throttle writes) until payment/vat cleared. That usually unblocks most customer workflows.

michael-finance: Checking now. Preliminary: invoice has VAT applied (20%) by automated tax engine. Customer location is Ireland with VAT-exempt flag not set in the billing profile. We need either an exemption certificate on file or a corrected invoice from accounting.

emma-cs: They uploaded an EU VAT exemption certificate in the ticket. I placed it in the attachment link above.

michael-finance: OK I see the file. Steps I need to do:
- verify VAT cert authenticity
- update customer billing profile to exempt
- reissue invoice/credit note for INV-2026-034 or apply credit to clear VAT
Once those are done I can mark invoice paid-on-hold and request reinstatement.

michael-finance: ETA 24-48h if cert is valid. If we need additional verification it's longer.

lara-risk: Also confirm payer on the PO matches the legal entity on VAT cert. If mismatch, escalate to legal.

emma-cs: PO payer is Orbitro Ltd., VAT cert shows Orbitro Ltd. as legal name. Should match.

ryan-support: From ops side, I can grant provisional access now if finance flags the account as "awaiting-vat-docs" and white-list the customer's IPs. That gives them read access to existing resources.

emma-cs: Customer is asking for full reinstatement. Can we do provisional until finance finishes the paperwork?

michael-finance: Let's do provisional access only. Full reinstatement requires invoice status cleared in ledger. I'll put a temporary hold on collection actions once I update the billing profile.

billing-bot: audit-log: invoice_update_attempt -> user:michael-finance action:validate_vat doc_id:attachment_2245

michael-finance: Ran validation script:
```
GET /billing/invoices/INV-2026-034
response: { status: "unpaid", tax: { rate: 0.20, applied: true } }
```
Need to set tax.applied=false for EU exempt before we reissue.

emma-cs: Thanks. I told the customer provisional access is possible. They said they can wait 48h but need minimal API calls for healthchecks.

ryan-support: I'll create a temporary ACL and flag session with expiry 48h. Can someone add a note to the ticket to not auto-escalate while hold is active?

emma-cs: Added note: "Hold requested by finance. Provisional access approved by ops until 2026-06-13 09:00 UTC. Do not re-suspend."

michael-finance: Updated billing profile to exempt and created credit note CN-2026-034-VAT to remove VAT. Marked invoice as adjusted. Pushing for accounting to finalize.

billing-bot: accounting-bot: credit_note_created -> CN-2026-034-VAT amount:€3,640 created_by:michael-finance

michael-finance: Once accounting posts the credit note and we run the settlement job, I will mark the dunning event resolved and request service reinstatement.

lara-risk: Keep me updated if anything odd appears in identity docs, otherwise low risk from a fraud POV.

emma-cs: Customer confirms they received provisional access and healthchecks are green. They appreciated quick response. :pray:

michael-finance: Settlement job scheduled for next run (in ~6h). If it succeeds I will mark invoice paid and ping @ryan-support for full restore.

ryan-support: Copy. I will stand by to restore full access once finance confirms. Thanks all.

emma-cs: Closing loop here — will update ticket when accounting confirms. Great cross-team work. :thumbsup:
